label: Elkanah

text.KJV 1CH 6:25: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.
text.BHSA 1CH 6:26: אֶלְקָנָ֑ה בנו אֶלְקָנָ֔ה צֹופַ֥י בְּנֹ֖ו וְנַ֥חַת בְּנֹֽו׃
text.KJV 1CH 6:26: As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
text.BHSA 1CH 6:27: אֱלִיאָ֥ב בְּנֹ֛ו יְרֹחָ֥ם בְּנֹ֖ו אֶלְקָנָ֥ה בְנֹֽו׃
text.KJV 1CH 6:27: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.

A.name: Elkanah
A.line: father of Zophai [Zuph] (1CH 6:26) and son of Mahath (1CH 6:35)
family: father-of zuph (Zuph, father of Tohu and ancestor of Samuel (1SA 1:1))

B.name: Elkanah
B.line: father of Amasai and Ahimoth (1CH 6:25) and son of Joel (1CH 6:36)

why: The repeated Elkanah in 6:26 introduces Zophai as בְּנוֹ, “his son,” identifying A, the father of Zophai/Zuph. B is the Elkanah whose sons Amasai and Ahimoth are named in the preceding verse.
